The release where RoboLedger reads books that are kept somewhere else, and says so on every screen that would otherwise mislead. Since v1.4.0 (November 1, 2026) the journal follows whichever system keeps each entity's books (QuickBooks with write-back, QuickBooks in shadow, an external ledger mirrored read-only, or RoboLedger itself), the inbox settles the bill or invoice a bank line pays, and the trial balance states its date. The series went out as fourteen patch releases; this file is the account of it as a whole.

## 📚 Books kept elsewhere

- **A ledger kept in another system shows as mirrored and read-only.** An external connection that keeps an entity's books shows its source name, whose books it keeps, and when its integration last reported a run. It has no Sync button, since the platform runs no sync for it. On those books a posted entry offers no Reverse and says to correct it in the ledger that keeps the books; an authored draft can still be edited (#568)
- **The journal follows the entity in scope.** In a group where QuickBooks keeps the parent's books and a subsidiary keeps its own, the subsidiary's journal is no longer treated as synced. The connection card names the entity whose books a QuickBooks connection keeps (#555)
- **No Reverse on books QuickBooks keeps in shadow.** The row says "QuickBooks keeps these books. Reverse it there.", as books with write-back already did. The API refused that reversal; the journal no longer offers it (#571)
- **The connection card says what the shadow write policy does:** QuickBooks stays the book of record, nothing is written to it, and the close posts nothing here. The helper text had described the opposite (#550)

## 🏦 Inbox and bank feeds

- **A bank line that pays an open bill or invoice settles it.** Such a line carries an "Open item" badge and filter, and approving it with the suggested account settles the bill or invoice it names, so the cost is not counted twice. Choosing another account asks whether it is a separate transaction (#552)
- **A batch approve says why it left a line alone** when the amount is far above that counterparty's usual: "unusual for this counterparty; open it and choose" (#553)
- **Disconnecting a bank feed says what it does.** QuickBooks, Mercury and Plaid each get a labelled Disconnect button and a dialog: access is given up, inbox lines and the counterparties only they used are deleted, posted entries stay without the provider's transaction details, and chart accounts stay but are unlinked (#567)
- **Mercury's screens carry its partner disclosures.** The setup form, the callback and the connection card show "Powered by Mercury" with its disclosures, and a deployment without a Mercury sign-in asks for each company's own read-only token. Mercury is not yet turned on in the hosted product (#567)

## 🔢 Numbers and statements

- **The trial balance states its date and reads through today,** in both the chart of accounts and US-GAAP views. It used to sum every posted entry with no date shown, so a posting dated ahead of today made it disagree with the statements. **This changes the figures shown when such postings exist** (#546)
- **A statement beside its comparative is headed with its own period,** and a balance sheet reads "As of" its date, in place of one span across both columns. Three or more columns keep the span (#546)
- **The consolidation entity's statements are headed "[group parent] (consolidated)",** since what it stamps are the group's statements (#546)
- **A block nothing checked no longer reads "Validation Failed"** on a filed report or in the Block Explorer (#546)
- **Editing a draft entry keeps its lines' dimensions.** They were dropped when a draft was saved from the edit form. The form preserves them; it does not yet edit them (#554)
- **The Plan page shows begin and end cash as two rows.** One concept filling two rows shared a key, and a row could be dropped or duplicated (#547)

## 📘 The close

- **The Closing Book does not read as all clear while two companies disagree.** On the consolidation entity, the badge is a warning ("Drafted: difference open") while an intercompany difference is listed, and each item ends "The difference stays in the consolidated statements." (#545, #546)
- **Plain words on the close panel:** the Close Period card says what closing does without naming a field, and a draft's source reads "System" in place of a raw code (#548, #549)

## 🌐 Public site

- **roboledger.ai leads with "AI accounting software you own."** The hero states the choice a company has: keep your books in QuickBooks or your ERP and read them here, or keep them here, for one company or a whole group (#557, #572)
- **Create an account is the primary button, Book 20 minutes the second,** and the price is named at the button: a graph for your books from $99 a month (#557, #564)
- **The ledger's pages leave the SEC repository to robosystems.ai** (#565)
- **A CDN failure keeps the last good sitemap and docs page** instead of caching a partial file or a 404 (#538, #540)

## 🐛 Bug fixes

- Home's recent transactions read "journal entry recorded" in place of the raw event type; possessives read "Roasters'" across Reports, Statements and the fiscal calendar; and the Receivables & Payables tie-out figures are legible in the dark theme (#546)

## 🔧 Infrastructure

- **`@robosystems/client` 2.35.0 → 2.42.0.** Operation streams are read over `fetch` with the credential in a header, in place of `EventSource` with a token in the URL. **`@robosystems/core` 0.19.0 → 0.21.7,** carrying the docs catalog and renderer the app now reads from core. **`@robosystems/report-components` 0.13.0 → 0.13.2,** with no change to how a statement renders (#538, #544, #556, #562, #566, #570)
- **Next 16.4.6** (#558)
- **CI:** `setup-uv` moves to v10.3.3, pinned by SHA (#543)
- **For forks and self-hosters:** the development stack's S3 server is on port 8333 (#551)

## 📦 Deploy notes

- **The API goes first.** A mirrored external ledger and the per-entity books keeper are served from robosystems v1.23.13; deploy this app after an API release at or past that is live. Against an older API nothing on screen changes.
- **No CloudFormation changes and no new variables or secrets.**
